selection: Completed attempts with recorded rewards, including completed retries and graded failures/timeouts. Interrupted, incomplete and ungraded attempts are excluded. Presence in this archive does not override the audited score-selection rules.
redaction_policy: Credential-shaped strings, including planted task credentials, use stable REDACTED markers. Encoded credentials are decoded, redacted and re-encoded. JSON numeric and boolean fields are preserved. Redacted JSON may be reserialized. Each artifact records its original and published SHA-256; unredacted artifacts retain their original bytes.
